children: UNIT TOGETHER WITH NERCAP ENERGY AND NEW LOADED ENERGY SIGN A STRATEGIC PARTNERSHIP AGREEMENT
PARTNERSHIP AGREEMENT FOR FOR DEPLOYMENT OF ENERCAP'S TECHNOLOGY IN GRID-SCALE APPLICATIONS IN GERMANY
PARTNERSHIP BEGINS WITH TWO GRID-CONNECTED PROJECTS IN GERMANY IDENTIFIED BY NLE, TOTALLING ABOUT 100 MWH OF NOMINAL CAPACITY
ENERCAP SUPERCAPACITOR STORAGE SYSTEMS WILL BE SUPPLIED THROUGH APEX ENERGY
TWO PROJECTS OF ABOUT 30 MWH AND 70 MWH RESPECTIVELY, WILL BE SUPPLIED FROM ENERCAP'S MANUFACTURING FACILITY IN DUBAI
PARTIES WILL COOPERATE IN DEVELOPING A PIPELINE OF FURTHER GRID-SCALE PROJECTS IN GERMANY AND EUROPE THROUGH 2028
